description: Route to capability matrix of every /api/v1 operation, paths as in openapi.json. capability_source is 'decorator' (requires_capability), 'body' (a check the handler or a helper makes before returning data; capability_keys lists the literal keys, empty when a helper resolves them) or 'none' (intentionally without one, see no_capability_reason). Generated by tools/api_surface.py at integration; never edit by hand.

DELETE /api/v1/chat/conversations/{conve.no_capability_reason: Chat has no capability keys by design: webvue.chat.service requires an active internal WebVue user and limits every row to the caller's conversations.

DELETE /api/v1/project-charter/catalogs/.no_capability_reason: Catalog write: the catalog models (webvue_pmo/models/project_charter_reference.py) require manage in create(), write() and unlink() unless the caller is privileged; those are stock names the analysis never credits.

GET /api/v1/admin/maintenance.no_capability_reason: Gated by maintenance_company(request.env), which requires the maintenance capability in its non-operator branch; the branch is conditional on its operator flag (never set by a route), so the analysis does not credit it.
